thread:
maya-cs: Heads-up: Solara QBR is Friday AM. Request from account exec: consolidated 60/90-day burn projections, 2 tangible mitigation plays, and a 1-page ops runbook for their infra team. Who can pick this up?

trevor-csm: I can drive the narrative + asks. Lee, can you pull 60/90-day token burn and high-tail seq-length breakdown? Need both embeddings and gen.

lee-data: On it. I'll include per-endpoint P95/P99 and note the new feature rollout dates that line up with the recent spike. ETA tonight. Uploading CSV + quick chart to our folder.

anya-finops: I'll assemble cost scenarios: baseline, conservative (10% throttle), aggressive (30% throttle), plus a quantization switch case. Will show gross $ impact and estimated latency change.

pranav-se: Technical mitigations we can propose: (A) enable per-route prefix KV caching for chat + short-term memcache for embeddings (est 8-15% savings), (B) route low-priority batch embed requests to a cheaper quantized endpoint with slight perf delta. I can draft short checklist for their ops team.

alert-bot: QBR template v4 uploaded at https://redwood.app/s/qbr-v4. Use slide 'Cost & Ask' for the commercial proposal.

maya-cs: Great. For renewal risk, they are on monthly credits with a tight runway. If 30-day outflow > current burn * 1.3 we should plan a commercial touch before renewal. Anya, can you model a 3-month prepay with a 6% discount vs status quo?

anya-finops: Yep. Preliminary: 3-month prepay at 6% reduces short-term churn risk and improves cash visibility; I'll include a sensitivity table (5/10/15% usage variance).

lee-data: Uploaded charts: https://redwood.app/plots/solara_burn.png and CSV: https://redwood.app/data/solara_burn.csv. Notable: embedding endpoint "embed-lookup" accounts for 48% of tokens; gen endpoints show longer tail after the rapid release.

pranav-se: Small note: switching to int8 quantized model cut per-token compute in our bench by ~11% for Solara's mix. Combined with caching that's material.

maya-cs: Runbook needs to be ops-friendly (commands + escalation). Marco-style snippet would be ideal. Trevor, want to own slide compilation?

trevor-csm: I'll assemble slides. Action items (tomorrow 2pm PT deadline): Lee - final charts + endpoint breakout; Anya - cost scenarios + prepay sensitivity; Pranav - ops runbook + short CLI commands; Maya - draft executive ask slide.

pranav-se: Runbook snippet to include in the deck (draft):
```
# Solara spend runbook (draft)
if daily_spend > baseline * 1.25:
  notify #customer-success + solara-ops
  enable_policy(endpoint="embed-lookup", throttle=0.3)
  enable_cache(scope="prefix", ttl=300)
  open incident: tag=cost-surge
  notify finops
elif daily_spend > baseline * 1.10:
  send warning to solara-ops
  enable_slo_mode(noncritical_endpoints=true)
```
I'll add exact CLI commands for their infra by tomorrow.

anya-finops: Alert thresholds I'm recommending: warning at 60% of monthly credits, escalate at 85%, hard throttle at 98% (auto fallback to cheaper model). Also include a commercial option: early-commit 3mo prepay (6% discount) + priority capacity.

maya-cs: Renewal risk marked as "watch" (medium). If we see runrate > +25% for 2 consecutive weeks, we'll loop in AMs for commercial outreach. Trevor - can you coordinate the exec ask wording?

trevor-csm: Will do. I'll draft a single-ask slide: 1) approve 3mo prepay offer OR 2) approve engineering mitigation plan + temporary throttle. Adding into the shared doc now.

lee-data: FYI I added a small note showing seq-length 95th percentile increased by 28% after feature flag flip. That explains the token uptick.

maya-cs: Perfect. Checkpoint: reconvene tomorrow 2pm PT to finalize. Please add any remaining asks to the shared doc by 11am PT. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
